result.paraphrase: ADATA XPG GAMMIX S5 1TB SSD, PCIe Gen3x4 M.2 2280 (up to 2100/1500 MB/s read/write). XPG GAMMIX S5 PCIe Gen3x4 M.2 2280 solid state drive for faster booting, loading, and transfers. Featuring NVMe 1.3 support and 3D NAND Flash, it delivers up to 4x the performance of SATA SSDs and up to 1TB capacity. Its built-in heatsink improves heat dissipation and can reduce temperatures by as much as 10°C. Ultra-fast PCIe Gen3x4 interface, NVMe 1.3 compatibility, 3D NAND Flash for greater capacity and durability, unique heatsink design, Advanced LDPC ECC Technology, HMB (Host Memory Buffer), and SLC Caching. Compact M.2 2280 form factor ideal for high-end desktops. Technical specifications: 1TB capacity, 3D TLC NAND, PCIe Gen3x4 interface, M.2 2280 form factor, 2,000,000-hour MTBF, dimensions 22 x 80 x 3.7 mm, weight 11.2 g, power use 0.33W active (typical) and 0.14W slumber (typical), operating temperature 0°C~70°C, storage temperature -40°C~85°C, 1500G/0.5ms shock resistance, RoHS/CE/FCC/BSMI/VCCI/KC certifications, 5-year warranty.
